en-US.name: Daylight - Menu Bar Calendar
en-US.subtitle: Lunar dates, moon & diary
en-US.description:
A little calendar for a clearer day. Daylight puts your calendar, moon phase and daily notes in your Mac menu bar.

YOUR DAY AT A GLANCE
Open a compact month calendar, select a date, and see its details without leaving your work. Choose between the Luna and Sol layouts, with light and dark appearances.

FOLLOW THE MOON AND SEASONS
Show lunar dates and the 24 solar terms, each with a hand-drawn botanical icon. Today's circular background follows the moon phase. Explore a simple moon summary or the 3D moon view.

KEEP YOUR PLANS CLOSE
Read events from your system calendars with your permission. Subscribe to public holiday calendars and choose which sources appear. Week numbers and different week-start rules help you navigate dates.

A SMALL SPACE FOR YOUR THOUGHTS
Write notes and todos for each day. Your diary stays on your Mac, and you can export it as JSON.

MADE FOR YOUR MENU BAR
Customize the status item, enable launch at login, and choose English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese or Thai.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, ads or analytics. Calendar access and location are optional. Location is used on your device for the 3D moon view; your diary and calendar events are not uploaded. Holiday calendars are downloaded only after you subscribe, then refreshed daily or weekly as you choose.

Requires macOS 13 or later.
en-US.promotionalText: A quiet home for dates, lunar seasons, the moon and daily notes — right in your Mac menu bar.

zh-Hans.name: 昼间 Daylight - 菜单栏日历
zh-Hans.subtitle: 农历节气、月相与每日随记
zh-Hans.keywords: 日历,菜单栏,农历,节气,月相,日记,待办,节假日,日期,周数,calendar,moon
zh-Hans.description:
小小日历，让每一天更清晰。昼间把日历、月相和每日随记放进 Mac 菜单栏，随时轻松查看。

今天，一眼就知道
打开简洁的月历，选择日期并查看当天详情。Luna 与 Sol 两种界面，支持浅色与深色外观。

跟随月亮与四季
按需显示农历和二十四节气，搭配细腻的植物线描节气图标。今天的圆形背景跟随当天月相变化，还可以查看简洁月相详情或探索 3D 月球。

把安排放在手边
经你允许后读取系统日历中的日程。订阅公共节假日日历，自选显示来源，支持周数和不同的每周起始规则。

为每天留一点记录
按日期写下想法和待办事项。日记保存在本机，也可以导出为 JSON。

为菜单栏而设计
自定义状态栏样式，支持开机启动，提供简体中文、繁体中文、英语和泰语界面。

隐私优先
无需账号，没有广告或使用分析。系统日历和定位权限均为可选；定位仅用于本机计算 3D 月相，日记和日程不会上传。节假日日历仅在你订阅后下载，并按你的选择每天或每周刷新。

需要 macOS 13 或更新版本。
zh-Hans.promotionalText: 农历、节气、月相与日记，在菜单栏里陪你过好每一天。

reviewNotes:
Changes in 2.0.6 for the previous review: (Guideline 4) the system permission prompts for calendar and location are now localized in every language the app supports (English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Thai), and non-Chinese system languages no longer see Chinese lunar text by default. (5.1.1(iv)) The screens shown before the calendar and location requests explain why access is needed and offer a single Continue button; if access was denied, they link to System Settings instead. A Privacy Policy link is under Settings > About.

Daylight is a menu bar utility (LSUIElement). After launch, click the moon/date item in the macOS menu bar; there is no Dock icon. If the item is hidden behind the notch, open Daylight again from Finder or Launchpad to show it. No account or sign-in is required. Settings: gear icon. Quit: Settings > Quit Daylight, or Command-Q while the popover is open. Privacy Policy and Help & Support links are under Settings > About.

Permissions (both optional; nothing is requested at launch):
- Calendar (read-only): select a day; the agenda card says 'Show events from your system calendars' with a Continue button that opens the system prompt. Also Settings > System calendar.
- Location (3D moon only): select a day, then click the moon readout in the day header (Luna layout) or the moon row (Sol layout); a short explanation with a Continue button precedes the system prompt. Without location the moon still renders.

Network: none by default. Holiday calendars are downloaded only after Settings > Holidays > select Mainland China or Hong Kong SAR > Subscribe & mark, then refreshed daily or weekly per the setting on that screen.

Lunar dates are optional (Settings > Lunar date) and are off by default for non-Chinese system languages. Diary export: Settings > Export diary. Notes and settings stay on the Mac. The Mac App Store build has App Sandbox enabled and contains no Sparkle updater or external update flow.
